7 Diwali releases, ranked by critics: the Indian films in theatres from 30 Oct to 9 Nov that drew at least four ratings from established outlets, ranked by the average of 68 published critic ratings. Only two clear 6/10.

1. Ramayana: Part 1 7.1 (21 ratings): Big-screen spectacle; expect more awe than emotion.
2. Scene 6.8 (13 ratings): Dark-comedy fans; Suriya sends up his own image.
3. Summer Holidays 5.3 (4 ratings): Families with children; gentle and simple.
4. Aadarsha Kutumbam 5.2 (9 ratings): Venkatesh fans; the first half is the draw.
5. Nakhrewaalii 4.6 (7 ratings): An undemanding rom-com, if you like the leads.
6. #Cult 4.1 (5 ratings): Slasher fans with a strong stomach only.
7. Mookuthi Amman 2 3.3 (9 ratings): Only for committed Nayanthara fans, critics suggest.

Score: for each film, its ratings converted to /10; the mean is rounded half-up to one decimal. A film needs at least 4 ratings, published on or after release. Smaller releases with fewer ratings are not ranked. idly has not watched these films; this post consolidates published reviews.

Ramayana: Part 1 edges Scene by 0.3: which would you book first?

Sources: Reviews consolidated from 123Telugu, ABP Live, Bollywood Hungama, Cinema Express, DNA India, DT Next, Deccan Chronicle, Filmfare, Firstpost, Great Andhra, Gulte, Hindustan Times, India TV, India Today, Indian Express, Koimoi, NDTV, New Indian Express, News18, Outlook, Pinkvilla, Rediff, Telugu360, The National, The Quint, The Week, Times Now, Times of India and Tribune India. Ratings read on the outlets' pages and in the thereviewmonk and Rotten Tomatoes critics lists.
